outcome.answer: To reuse workflows and reduce forgetting, organize past interaction trajectories by their underlying workflow, extract reusable skills, and retrieve relevant skills and trajectories to guide new tasks; LifeMem reports reduced forgetting and improved cross-task transfer using this approach [1]. TRIAGE offers another pattern: store execution trajectories as skills, reuse exact matches directly, substitute parameters for similar queries, and run the full agent loop for novel queries [10]. Abstract procedural memories may transfer more reliably than detailed trajectories, but memory retrieval and organization can themselves cause forgetting [3].
